weaknesses: The abstract does not clearly articulate the specific contributions of the proposed MetaTool benchmark and ToolE dataset.
The claims regarding the performance of LLMs in tool selection are not sufficiently supported by the experimental results presented.
The novelty of the proposed approach is not adequately distinguished from prior work, particularly in the context of existing benchmarks for tool usage in LLMs.
strengths: The introduction of the ToolE dataset is a valuable contribution for evaluating tool usage awareness in LLMs.
The paper provides a systematic approach to analyzing the catapult dynamics in neural networks, which is a relevant and timely topic.
